blocks.text: MANILA — Artificial intelligence (AI) and citizen-developed digital tools are speeding up the Senate’s scrutiny of the proposed PHP7.2-trillion national budget, giving Filipinos an online platform to track congressional project insertions and changes in funding allocations. During the Senate Committee on Finance hearing on Monday, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said civil society organizations (CSOs) produced an analysis of the House-approved 2027 budget within a day using AI and computer coding. He noted that similar assessments previously took one to two weeks, giving senators less time to examine questionable allocations before deliberations.
